**WorldView 3 Cloud Masking**

This script applies the Omnimask algorithm for cloud and shadow masking to prepare the data input for Kremetart February imagery for further analysis.

The workflow begins by loading the required packages.

```{r}
#| label: Packages

library(terra)
library(sf)
library(reticulate) # provides an R interface to Python modules, classes, and functions.
library(RStoolbox)

```

**Pansharpening**

The multispectral mosaics for Kremetart and Mapungubwe were pansharpened using their corresponding panchromatic mosaics in GDAL 3.10.3. Pansharpening was performed using -r cubic resampling through the GDAL command-line utility, which supports multi-band multispectral imagery and can be executed directly for batch processing.

**Cloud and shadow masking**

Cloud and shadow masking is performed using the OmnicloudMask model. As the model is implemented in Python, the reticulate package is used to interface Python within the R environment.

The OmnicloudMask model was trained on Sentinel-2 imagery with a spatial resolution of 10 m. To address compatibility issues, the higher-resolution WorldView-3 imagery (0.3 m) was resampled to 10 m before inference.

```{python}

# mask_krem_feb.py
# Cloud and shadow mask for the Kremetart February pansharpened product.

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import rasterio
from rasterio.enums import Resampling
from omnicloudmask import predict_from_array

DATA_ROOT = r"Data\Objective 3 Manuscript\Satellite Data\Data"

IMAGE_PATH = rf"{DATA_ROOT}\Pansharpened\krem_feb_pansharpened.tif"
MASK_PATH  = rf"{DATA_ROOT}\Masks\krem_feb_mask_10m.tif"

# Band positions in the pansharpened file, which follows WorldView-3 order:
# coastal, blue, green, yellow, red, red_edge, nir1, nir2.
RED_BAND, GREEN_BAND, NIR_BAND = 5, 3, 7

# OmniCloudMask expects input between 10 m and 50 m, so the 0.3 m product
# is downsampled by a factor of roughly 33 before inference.
TARGET_RESOLUTION = 10.0

# Create the output folder, including any missing parent folders, before
# anything is computed. This is what failed previously: GDAL will not create
# a directory for you, so the write raised an error after inference had run.
Path(MASK_PATH).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

with rasterio.open(IMAGE_PATH) as src:

    # Work out the output shape that yields approximately 10 m pixels.
    scale = src.res[0] / TARGET_RESOLUTION
    out_height = int(src.height * scale)
    out_width  = int(src.width  * scale)

    # Block averaging is the correct downsampling function for continuous
    # radiometry: each coarse pixel becomes the mean of its constituents.
    stack = src.read(
        [RED_BAND, GREEN_BAND, NIR_BAND],
        out_shape=(3, out_height, out_width),
        resampling=Resampling.average
    ).astype("float32")

    # The affine transform must be rebuilt for the coarser grid, otherwise
    # the mask will not align with the imagery it was derived from.
    transform = src.transform * src.transform.scale(
        src.width  / out_width,
        src.height / out_height
    )
    crs = src.crs

print(f"Running inference on {out_height} x {out_width} pixels at ~10 m")

# Returns 0 clear, 1 thick cloud, 2 thin cloud, 3 cloud shadow.
# np.squeeze removes the leading singleton dimension the function returns.
mask = np.squeeze(predict_from_array(stack)).astype("uint8")

with rasterio.open(
    MASK_PATH, "w",
    driver="GTiff",
    height=mask.shape[0], width=mask.shape[1],
    count=1, dtype="uint8",
    crs=crs, transform=transform,
    compress="deflate"
) as dst:
    dst.write(mask, 1)

# Reported only after the write has succeeded, so a failure cannot be
# mistaken for a completed run.
print(f"\nWritten: {MASK_PATH}")
print(f"  clear:       {(mask == 0).mean():.1%}")
print(f"  thick cloud: {(mask == 1).mean():.2%}")
print(f"  thin cloud:  {(mask == 2).mean():.2%}")
print(f"  shadow:      {(mask == 3).mean():.2%}")



```

Apply the generated mask to the 0.3m WorldView-3 image

```{r}

wv3_band_names <- c("coastal", "blue", "green", "yellow",
                    "red", "red_edge", "nir1", "nir2")

# Create the output folders, since terra will not create them either.
dir.create("Data/Masked",       recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("Data/Coregistered", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

krem_feb <- rast("Data/Pansharpened/krem_feb_pansharpened.tif")
names(krem_feb) <- wv3_band_names

feb_mask_coarse <- rast("Data/Masks/krem_feb_mask_10m.tif")

# Any class above zero is thick cloud, thin cloud or shadow.
feb_mask_binary <- feb_mask_coarse > 0

# A maximum filter over a 5x5 window expands the masked area by two cells in
# every direction, a 20 m buffer at the mask's own resolution. Cloud shadow
# boundaries are diffuse, and the penumbra extends beyond what the classifier
# flags, so partially shadowed crowns would otherwise survive into the output
# and fragment during segmentation.
feb_mask_dilated <- focal(feb_mask_binary, w = 5, fun = "max", na.rm = TRUE)

# Nearest neighbour is mandatory for categorical data. Averaging would create
# intermediate values corresponding to no class.
feb_mask_fine <- resample(feb_mask_dilated, krem_feb, method = "near")

# Set masked pixels to NA across all eight bands, writing straight to disk
# rather than holding a multi-gigabyte result in memory.
krem_feb_masked <- mask(
  krem_feb, feb_mask_fine,
  maskvalues = 1, updatevalue = NA,
  filename = "Data/Masked/krem_feb_masked.tif",
  overwrite = TRUE,
  datatype = "INT2U",
  NAflag   = 65535,
  gdal = c("COMPRESS=ZSTD", "TILED=YES", "BIGTIFF=YES", "NUM_THREADS=ALL_CPUS")
)

krem_feb_masked

#plotRGB(krem_feb_masked, r=5, g=3, b=2, stretch="lin", axes=TRUE, main="Krem feb 2024")

```

**Image-to-image co-registration**

This sections performs image co-registration of WorldView-3 multispectral imagery from Kremetart, South Africa \| Target: February \| Reference: July. Method: mutual information (RStoolbox::coregisterImages)

```{r}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Co-registration: Kremetart February to July (RStoolbox, two-stage MI)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

library(terra)
library(RStoolbox)

# ---- Paths ----
base_dir <- "/Objective 3 Manuscript/Satellite Data/Data"

target_path <- file.path(base_dir, "Masked",       "krem_feb_masked.tif")
ref_path    <- file.path(base_dir, "Pansharpened", "krem_july_pansharpened.tif")
out_path    <- file.path(base_dir, "Coregistered", "krem_feb_coreg.tif")

dir.create(dirname(out_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
stopifnot(file.exists(target_path), file.exists(ref_path))

wv3_band_names <- c("coastal", "blue", "green", "yellow",
                    "red", "red_edge", "nir1", "nir2")

# ---- Load ----
krem_target <- rast(target_path)   # February, moved
krem_ref    <- rast(ref_path)      # July, fixed

names(krem_target) <- wv3_band_names
names(krem_ref)    <- wv3_band_names

# CRS and pixel size must match or the search is meaningless.
stopifnot(
  same.crs(krem_target, krem_ref),
  all(abs(res(krem_target) - res(krem_ref)) < 1e-6)
)

# ---- Prepare search bands ----
search_band <- 5   # red: stable features across the wet-dry transition

overlap     <- intersect(ext(krem_target), ext(krem_ref))
target_band <- crop(krem_target[[search_band]], overlap)
ref_band    <- crop(krem_ref[[search_band]],    overlap)

# Mask both identically, so cloud gaps cannot bias the joint histogram.

valid_cells   <- !is.na(target_band)
target_search <- subst(mask(target_band, valid_cells, maskvalues = FALSE), NA, 0)
ref_search    <- subst(mask(ref_band,    valid_cells, maskvalues = FALSE), NA, 0)

rm(target_band, ref_band, valid_cells)

# coarse search at 1.2 m

target_coarse <- aggregate(target_search, fact = 4, fun = "mean")
ref_coarse    <- aggregate(ref_search,    fact = 4, fun = "mean")

coreg_coarse <- coregisterImages(
  img = target_coarse, ref = ref_coarse,
  shift = 10, shiftInc = 1,          # +/- 12 m
  nSamples = 10000, nBins = 100,
  reportStats = TRUE, verbose = TRUE
)

# Derive the offset from the returned extent, not from bestShift units.

dx_coarse <- xmin(coreg_coarse$coregImg) - xmin(target_coarse)
dy_coarse <- ymin(coreg_coarse$coregImg) - ymin(target_coarse)

cat(sprintf("Coarse: %+.2f m E, %+.2f m N\n", dx_coarse, dy_coarse))

if (max(abs(c(dx_coarse, dy_coarse))) >= 10 * res(target_coarse)[1]) {
  warning("Coarse shift hit the search limit; widen and re-run.")
}

# ---- Stage 2: refinement at 0.3 m ----
target_shifted <- shift(target_search, dx = dx_coarse, dy = dy_coarse)

coreg_fine <- coregisterImages(
  img = target_shifted, ref = ref_search,
  shift = 4, shiftInc = 1,           # +/- 1.2 m
  nSamples = 20000, nBins = 100,
  reportStats = TRUE, verbose = TRUE
)

dx_fine <- xmin(coreg_fine$coregImg) - xmin(target_shifted)
dy_fine <- ymin(coreg_fine$coregImg) - ymin(target_shifted)

if (max(abs(c(dx_fine, dy_fine))) >= 4 * res(target_shifted)[1]) {
  warning("Fine shift hit the search limit; widen and re-run.")
}

dx_total <- dx_coarse + dx_fine
dy_total <- dy_coarse + dy_fine

cat(sprintf("Total:  %+.2f m E, %+.2f m N  (%+.1f, %+.1f px)\n",
            dx_total, dy_total,
            dx_total / xres(krem_target), dy_total / yres(krem_target)))

# Apply to all eight bands

krem_feb_aligned <- shift(krem_target, dx = dx_total, dy = dy_total)

# ---- Export

writeRaster(
  krem_feb_aligned,
  filename  = out_path,
  datatype  = "INT2U",
  NAflag    = 65535,                 # keep masked pixels distinct from 0
  gdal      = c("COMPRESS=ZSTD", "TILED=YES", "BIGTIFF=YES",
                "NUM_THREADS=ALL_CPUS"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

# Visual check

check_window <- ext(762000, 762200, 7462500, 7462700)   # adjust to your scene

op <- par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plotRGB(crop(krem_ref,          check_window), r = 5, g = 3, b = 2,
        stretch = "lin", main = "July (reference)")
plotRGB(crop(krem_feb_aligned,  check_window), r = 5, g = 3, b = 2,
        stretch = "lin", main = "February (aligned)")
par(op)

cat("\nWritten:", out_path, "\n")


```
